cases.text:
Yes, absolutely! You can use a Trailforge gift card to pay for your order. According to **kb/15-gift-cards.md**, gift cards can be used **online or in-store**, so you're all set to apply it at checkout.

If you need to check your gift card balance beforehand, you can do so on the website using your card number and PIN.

Is there anything else I can help you with?
